title: Pacha.Cart Ecosystem
description: An AI-powered grocery e-commerce platform featuring real-time flash sales, automated inventory replenishment logic, and high-performance MERN architecture.
longDescription: Pacha.Cart is a full-stack e-commerce platform engineered for instant grocery fulfillment. Built with the MERN stack, it features dynamic flash sale triggers, secure Razorpay checkout integration, cloud asset management via Cloudinary, and intelligent automated stock replenishment algorithms to optimize inventory lifecycle.
features: Real-time dynamic pricing & flash sale countdown engine
Automated stock level replenishment alerts & logic
Razorpay payment gateway & instant order verification
Cloudinary image optimization & responsive media delivery
Framer Motion interactive UI micro-animations

title: Springs Academy Management System
description: A comprehensive educational office platform managing student admissions, staff HR directories, automated fee collection ledgers, and course tracking.
longDescription: Engineered a full-stack office management platform for educational institutions. Features multi-tiered RBAC (Super Admin, Admin, Employee) with JWT auth, real-time fee collection ledgers, ISO-compliant PDF receipt generation, and Cloudinary document integration.
features: Full-stack architecture for student admissions & staff HR directories
Automated accounting ledger for fee collections & ISO-compliant PDF receipt generation
Multi-tiered RBAC (Super Admin, Admin, Employee) with JWT auth & Cloudinary media handling
Optimized database throughput with Mongoose sparse indexing & collision-free counters

title: Resort Booking System
description: A full-stack resort booking and management platform with calendar availability, dynamic pricing packages, and single-page A4 PDF/PNG invoice generation.
longDescription: Developed a resort booking and guest management platform built with React (Vite), Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Features an interactive calendar timeline, mobile-responsive single-page A4 invoice engine (PDF/PNG), secure JWT authentication, and in-memory fallbacks for offline resilience.
features: Interactive booking calendar & staycation/daycation package pricing engine
Automated mobile-responsive single-page A4 PDF & PNG invoice engine with download export
Secure JWT authentication & dynamic pricing algorithms
In-memory data fallbacks for high uptime & offline resilience

title: Le Tohfa Luxury Resort
description: An organic luxury farm resort experience featuring glassmorphic aesthetics, real-time suite reservation engine, and integrated payment workflows.
longDescription: Le Tohfa Resort is a custom luxury hospitality experience platform crafted for premium eco-tourism. It delivers a fluid glassmorphic design system, an intuitive multi-step booking engine, date-picker availability calendars, and Razorpay transaction processing for effortless guest reservations.
features: Glassmorphic aesthetic & fluid responsive design system
Real-time room availability & booking reservation flow
Integrated Razorpay payment gateway for instant deposits
Custom room showcase gallery with smooth transitions
Mobile-optimized touch interactions & layout

title: Nyora Travel Planner
description: An AI-powered luxury travel management platform featuring automated itinerary generation, real-time weather integration, and custom travel routing.
longDescription: Nyora Travel Planner simplifies complex multi-city vacation planning. By combining AI recommendation algorithms with live weather telemetry, Nyora generates optimized daily itineraries, hotel recommendations, and activity schedules wrapped in a dark-cyber visual aesthetic.
features: Automated AI itinerary generation based on user preferences
Live weather forecast integration for travel destination insights
Custom destination bookmarking & itinerary customization
Dark glassmorphic interface with interactive map previews

title: Sajna's Cake Boutique
description: A boutique culinary landing page for a home bakery, featuring luxury visual storytelling, animated product showcases, and instant WhatsApp order CTAs.
longDescription: A sleek digital showcase designed for a high-end custom cake studio. Built to maximize order conversions through immersive visual storytelling, interactive menu categories, customer testimonials, and direct WhatsApp order dispatch.
features: Interactive cake flavor & design gallery filters
Direct WhatsApp order integration with pre-filled items
High-definition lazy-loaded image storytelling
Ultra-fast page load times and mobile responsive layout
